messages:
Ana: CI alert: eval-runner shows a 12% regression on answer-exact-match for model x-2 when using synthetic promptset fixtures.
Mike: Can you paste the failing run id?
Ana: run=ci/2026-03-19/789
Ana: Attaching snippet of the diff:
Ana: ```
metric: exact_match
baseline: 0.842
current: 0.740
```
EvalBot: test/eval/runner/123 FAILED — metric delta -0.102 (threshold 0.05)
Cheyenne: hmm did we swap tokenizers? synthetic fixtures use placeholder tokens; real prompts use full utf8 punctuation.
Kartik: I noticed fixture generator uses `tokenize(..., normalize=True)` in most cases but for synthetic we call `simple_split()` which doesn't apply BPE.
Mike: That could cause token count mismatch -> different truncation -> scoring shift.
Ana: Also random seed drift: fixtures regenerated on master at 2026-03-18 22:01 without recording seed.
Cheyenne: Repro steps: checkout commit abc123, run `python eval_runner.py --prompts=fixtures/synth_v2.json --model=... --seed=42`
Ana: I ran with seed=42 and got baseline-like numbers. With no seed I get the failing delta.
Kartik: Suggestion: add deterministic fixture header: {"_meta": {"generator_seed": X, "tokenizer": "redwood/bpe-v1"}}
Mike: Also fix CI to pin tokenizer binary via env var `EVAL_TOKENIZER=redwood/bpe-v1`
Cheyenne: I'll open a tiny PR to update synthetic generator and the eval harness tokenization path.
Ana: thanks — please add an eval regression test that compares tokenized lengths.
EvalBot: PR opened: #2847 by Cheyenne — CI rerun queued :github:
Sam: FYI I saw one weird case where `‘` vs `'` changed embedding distances, maybe normalize quotes as well.
Ana: good call — normalize quotes, normalize whitespace. Add that to the fixture schema.
Mike: ok let's aim to merge today; if CI still flags, fallback policy to use cached KV for x-2 model.
Ana: assigning followups: @Cheyenne update generator, @Kartik add schema, @Mike add CI env pin, @Sam add normalization tests :thumbsup:
Cheyenne: on it.
